artboards.title: Consolidated AIP — Annex B grid (General sector)
Clicking an activity — the existing review modal, unchanged

annotations.text:
RESOLVED 2026-09-14 — printed figures

Every amount rounded up to the thousand first, then added; MOOE and CO carry the +30% (DECISION G); Total = PS + MOOE + CO. This page previews the future Excel, so its figures are the Excel's — not the exact amounts AIP Entry shows. The note under the grid says why.

⚠️ G5 is still provisional — built as uplift, then round.

RESOLVED 2026-09-14 — offices not yet with PPDO are left out of the grid

Only With PPDO and Accepted offices appear. A sent-back office drops out until it is re-submitted. The page header and the sector tabs still say how many of the total have submitted.

RESOLVED 2026-09-14 — keep comments

The same modal the review search opens, comment rail included. Read-only for the activity itself.

RESOLVED 2026-09-14 — amounts carry .00, like the FY2027 file

Status pills, underlined activity names and the 'X of 11 submitted' line stay screen-only; the Excel will not carry them.

FOLLOWS THE FORM SPEC

• Four sector tabs = the four sheets.
• Columns A–R with the DBM numbers; eSRE has none.
• Level shows as indent (B/C/D/E in the file); program and project rows carry no amounts.
• Office row = subtotal of its lines; TOTAL = sum of office rows.
• Units stated on the AMOUNT header.
• Only cross-office reviewers can open it.
• No Export button yet — the Excel is Phase 5 (V18-60).
